title: imap: E2E smoke test: imap-client connects and reads a newsgroup
description: Create crates/imap/tests/e2e_smoke.rs. Uses the imap crate (not imap-next -- the higher-level client crate) to connect to the server as a real client. Algorithm: (1) spawn usenet-ipfs-imap server in-process on a random port with in-memory stores pre-seeded with two articles in comp.lang.rust; (2) connect with imap client using AUTH=PLAIN with test credentials; (3) SELECT comp.lang.rust; (4) FETCH 1:2 FLAGS; (5) STORE 1 +FLAGS (Seen); (6) SEARCH UNSEEN -> should return [2]; (7) EXPUNGE (no messages with Deleted -> empty expunge); (8) LOGOUT. Verify each step produces expected responses without errors. Use in-memory stores (MemIpfsStore, in-memory SQLite). This test exercises the full IMAP stack including TLS (use insecure/non-TLS mode or self-signed cert in test).
